title: General Physics I
description: Introductory algebra-based mechanics. Life Science applications.
notes: Not open for credit to students registered in or with credit in any of PHYS 102, PHYS 110, PHYS 112, PHYS 120, PHYS 122.
Students intending to take further courses in Physics should consider PHYS 110 or PHYS 120 rather than PHYS 102A.
recommendations: One of MATH 100, MATH 102, MATH 109 recommended prior to or in conjunction with PHYS 102A.
